title: Blindsight: accurate visual discrimination without visual awareness

statements.text: A patient of Weiskrantz with primary visual cortex lesions, blind in his left visual field, could point to a light in that field and tell vertical from horizontal bars with near-perfect accuracy while insisting he was only guessing. Perceptual judgments do not require consciously available perceptions.

sources.quote: puts paid to the idea that perceptual judgments require consciously available perceptions
